QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_36

question.text: Which of the following is NOT an exit route from an investee/portfolio company for a pre-IPO Cat III AIF?

answer.text: Offer for sale through an IPO (secondary share sale)
Trade sale (secondary sale to another fund)
Strategic sale / M&A to a corporate buyer
Mandatory fund-level MMR tax deduction before distribution

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 13.4.3 lists IPO, secondary/trade sale, strategic/M&A, corporate/promoter buyback (put option), and corporate liquidation as exit routes. Option D is a TAXATION item (Cat III is taxed at fund level at MMR/AOP), not an exit route. **The Trap:** The trap sets up a plausible-sounding wrong item by mixing tax and exit. Options A, B, C are literally the PDF list. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-D tests Cat I/II exit routes (some overlap: IPO, M&A, buyback, liquidation). Cat III primary focus is OPEN-ENDED redemption (not investee exits). **Manager's Pro-Tip:** For the pre-IPO sleeve of a Cat III fund, maintain a live exit-route matrix per portfolio company: IPO readiness, strategic-buyer list, promoter-put expiry, liquidation scenario. Refresh quarterly with investment-banker feedback.
